title: Hardware calibration manifest and publication plan for model onboarding (A100/H100/L40S/MI300)
creator: Priya Iyer
description: Objective: Produce a signed, machine-readable hardware calibration manifest and a publication workflow for new model variants targeted at A100, H100, L40S, and MI300 families. Deliverables: 1) calibration-manifest JSON schema and example artifacts, 2) automated validation harness (latency/throughput/P99/90/50), 3) publication pipeline that pushes stable manifests to the model catalog and CDN with canary rollout, 4) rollback and re-pin playbook, and 5) docs for consumers (SDK/runtime) describing how to consume manifests and fallback rules.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Manifest schema v1 published and validated by test harness; 2) For a given model variant, at least 3 runs within 48h produce p99 latency within 10% and throughput variance <12%; 3) Publication pipeline creates signed manifest artifact and updates catalog entry automatically on successful validation; 4) Canary rollout to 5% of traffic with automatic revert if p99 increase >15% or error rate >0.5% for 10 minutes; 5) Release notes and migration instructions published to Confluence and linked in console.
public_notes: Publishing plan: 1) Draft manifest created from bench-run outputs (bench-run job: infra/bench/bench-onnboarding-2026-03), 2) Run calibration harness across target SKUs with standardized payloads (seq lens 32/128/512), 3) Aggregate kernel selection, quantization flags, observed memory pressure, batch size recommendations, and KV cache behavior into the manifest fields, 4) Sign manifest with platform key and upload to CDN under /model-manifests/runtime-1.20/, 5) Trigger console cache clear so dashboards and rollout logic read new manifest immediately.
